_comment_secrets: This file is checked into source. Do NOT add secrets here. For local dev put values in appsettings.Development.json (gitignored) or use 'dotnet user-secrets'. For UAT/LIVE use environment variables (double-underscore convention, e.g. EmailProviders__Senders__Default__Password). Empty string means 'must be supplied at runtime'.

JwtSettings._comment: Override Key in non-dev via env var JwtSettings__Key. Must be a long random secret.

Seed._comment: Development-only SuperAdmin. Not created outside Development unless ForceAdmin=true. Change the password immediately.

HypeGridEmail._comment_bcc: AdminNotificationBccEmails BCCs extra inboxes on INTERNAL lead notifications only (never on customer acknowledgements). Comma/semicolon-separated. Left empty here; prefer setting it as an env var / app-pool setting (HypeGridEmail__AdminNotificationBccEmails) so it can change without a redeploy.

EmailProviders._comment: SMTP sender pool. Non-secret SMTP config (host/port/ssl/from/username) lives here. ONLY passwords are supplied at runtime via env vars / app-pool settings (EmailProviders__Senders__<Name>__Password) and must never be committed. A sender with an empty Host is treated as 'not configured' and falls back to 'Default' (same mailbox), so it needs no separate password.

NoReply._comment: Phase 1: Host intentionally empty -> falls back to 'Default' (same noreply@ mailbox, identical From). No NoReply password needed. To give NoReply its own SMTP login later, set Host=mail.hypegrid.co.za and supply EmailProviders__Senders__NoReply__Password.

Campaigns._comment: Phase 1: unconfigured (empty Host) -> falls back to 'Default'. To enable a branded From, create campaigns@hypegrid.co.za, set Host=mail.hypegrid.co.za, and supply EmailProviders__Senders__Campaigns__Password.

Creators._comment: Phase 1: unconfigured (empty Host) -> falls back to 'Default'. To enable a branded From, create creators@hypegrid.co.za, set Host=mail.hypegrid.co.za, and supply EmailProviders__Senders__Creators__Password.

AssetStorage._comment: Image/object storage for marketing assets. Provider 'R2' (Cloudflare) in prod, 'Local' for dev disk. R2 keys are SECRETS — supply via env vars AssetStorage__R2__AccessKeyId / __SecretAccessKey, never commit them. See docs/CONFIGURATION.md.
